difficulty_reason: The algebraic-spaces form of the compatibility of the derivation action with etale localisation: the proof justifies the identification that defines the transported derivation using compatibility of the sheaf of differentials with etale localisation on both source and target, then reduces the commuting square to the schemes case. The reduction to the schemes statement together with the identification of differentials under etale localisation is what carries the argument; the proof is short because the substantive verification was done on the schemes side. Retained author proof at lines 3950-3972.

dedup.scope: Cross-chapter same-name pair compared by hypothesis and conclusion: the schemes-side lemma-action-by-derivations-etale-localization states the same commuting square for first order thickenings of schemes. The two assert the same compatibility, so the schemes form is the special case and this algebraic-spaces form is the more general one. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for spaces-more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the schemes version works with first order thickenings of schemes; this one with thickenings of algebraic spaces over S. Conclusion difference: none, both assert the commuting square for the transported derivation action.
